definitions.gloss: living together as two; a two-person household
definitions.explanation: Two people sharing a home, such as a couple, a parent and child, or two friends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{二人暮|ふたりぐ}らしだ。
examples.english: I live with my mother, just the two of us.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{二人暮|ふたりぐ}らし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: We got married and started living together.

examples.japanese: {二人暮|ふたりぐ}らしなら、⟦もう{少|すこ}し→もう少し：33467_mousukoshi⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}した→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: If two of you are going to live together, you should look for a slightly bigger place.

notes:
Part of a set of words for household size: ⟦{一人暮|ひとりぐ}らし→一人暮らし：03142_hitorigurashi⟧ (living alone), {二人暮|ふたりぐ}らし, {三人暮|さんにんぐ}らし. ⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧ (living, life) becomes ぐらし in compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二人暮|ふたりぐ}らし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める: to start living together
- ⟦{親子|おやこ}→親子：10430_oyako⟧{二人暮|ふたりぐ}らし: a parent and child living together
- {二人暮|ふたりぐ}らし{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧: an apartment for two

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{同棲|どうせい}→同棲：11903_dousei⟧: living together as an unmarried couple
- ⟦{一人暮|ひとりぐ}らし→一人暮らし：03142_hitorigurashi⟧: living alone
